svg.data-weight-note: with all FRUs installed (guide Table 5; datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-cable-manager: 6RU with the cable management system fitted (guide, QFX5700 Physical Specifications)
svg.data-throughput: up to 12.8 Tbps unidirectional, 25.6 Tbps bidirectional (datasheet Table 1)
svg.data-line-cards: FPC 0 to 7 take QFX5K-FPC-4CD (4 x 400G), QFX5K-FPC-16C (16 x 100G) or QFX5K-FPC-20Y (20 x 10/25/50G); at most 144 logical ports
svg.data-power-typical-scope: eight QFX5K-FPC-16C cards, 25 C, 50 percent IMIX load, no MACsec, no transceivers (guide Table 9); the 20Y and 4CD builds are 751 W and 1095 W
svg.data-power-max-scope: eight QFX5K-FPC-16C cards, 40 C, SR optics, 100 percent IMIX load, MACsec on (guide Table 9); the 20Y and 4CD builds are 1622 W and 1762 W
svg.data-psu-input-ac: 200 to 277 VAC rated, 180 to 305 VAC, 47 to 63 Hz; the supplies detect HVDC (190 to 400 VDC) as well (guide Table 8)
svg.data-psu-input-dc: 40 to 72 VDC, rated 48 to 60 VDC; the input current selector sets 60 A (2700 W, 2200 W under the warning voltage) or 80 A (3000 W) (guide Tables 12)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 40 C (datasheet; the guide's Table 21 prints the same range as the non-operating temperature)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 85 C shipping and storage (guide Table 21; the datasheet prints 70 C)
svg.data-humidity: 55 to 70 percent non-condensing (guide Table 21; the datasheet prints 5 to 90 percent)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Hewitt Lake 6-core x86 at 2.9 GHz in each Routing and Control Board
svg.data-memory: 32 GB DDR4 (two 16 GB DIMMs), expandable to 64 GB
svg.data-storage: two 100 GB M.2 SATA or NVMe SSDs per Routing and Control Board
svg.data-timing: BITS RJ-45 jack, 10 MHz and PPS SMB connectors in and out, on each Routing and Control Board
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 on the Routing and Control Board, autosensing 10/100/1000 with link and activity lamps
svg.data-console: CON RJ-45 serial on the Routing and Control Board
svg.data-usb: one USB 2.0/3.0 port on the Routing and Control Board
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15, ICES-003, BS EN 55032, BS EN 55035, EN 300 386, CISPR 32, CISPR 35, IEC/EN 61000 series (datasheet)
svg.data-materials: RoHS 6/6, China RoHS, REACH, WEEE; power supply efficiency 80 Plus Silver (datasheet)
svg.data-seismic: tested and meets GR-63 (guide Table 21); designed for GR-63 Zone 4 (datasheet)
svg.data-telco: GR-1089-Core Issue 8; Deutsche Telekom 1TR9; BT GS7; CLEI code (datasheet)
